title: Rate Card — On-Site Controls Escalation under the Building Automation Service Plans
content:
# Rate Card — On-Site Controls Escalation under the Building Automation Service Plans

The on-site controls escalation entitlement of the Building Automation Service Plans is set per tier: whether an on-site controls visit is included when the remote attempt fails, how many on-site controls visits are included per plan year, the on-site controls technician rate for work beyond the included visits, and the number of business days to get a controls technician on site after a remote attempt fails.

| Tier | On-site escalation | On-site visits included per plan year | Controls technician rate (USD per hour) | On-site response (business days) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Controls Help Desk Subscription | not included | 0 | 175 | 10 |
| Alarm Monitoring Plan | not included | 0 | 168 | 7 |
| Scheduled Controls Service Plan | included | 2 | 162 | 5 |
| Software Assurance & Upgrade Plan | included | 2 | 156 | 5 |
| Remote Optimization Plan | included | 4 | 150 | 3 |
| Integrated Building Automation Partnership | included | 12 | 144 | 1 |

Notes to the card:

- The controls technician rate is the rate for on-site controls work beyond the included visits. It is carried at every tier, including the two tiers that include no on-site escalation, because on-site controls work can still be carried out at those tiers as billed work.
- The on-site response figure counts business days after a remote attempt fails.
- Illustrative figure (hypothetical): two hours of on-site controls work beyond the included visits under the Remote Optimization Plan come to 2 multiplied by 150 USD, that is 300 USD, at this card's rate.
